description: Recovering a soft-deleted Automation account is a PUT with `properties.createMode: "Recover"` and the deleted account's `properties.automationAccountId` (portal-only feature, absent from the spec). Free-trial subscriptions allow one account per region and count soft-deleted accounts for 30 days, so recreating an account requires recovering it.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Set to `Recover` to restore a soft-deleted account with the same name.
Automation account ID (GUID) of the soft-deleted account to recover; required with `createMode: Recover`.
